title: 第二十三章 是不是他们欺负你第二十四章 都留下来
slug: 老太太不服老修仙界里做烧烤
content_zh:
“婆婆！我来了！”
成功筑基的夏景景出关后立马来找叶晚秋，可是当她看到满院子的人时，惊讶到下巴都快要掉下来了。
她不过只是两天没有过来，这是什么情况？婆婆的院子里怎么突然多了这么多人？
还有围在叶晚秋身边一口一个叫着婆婆的，这是你们婆婆吗你们就叫！
夏景景越想心里就越是委屈，快步走进院子。
“婆婆！”
她这一声喊那叫一个幽怨，上一秒喧闹的院子瞬间安静下来。
夏景景快步走到叶晚秋身边，挽住她的胳膊。
“婆婆，他们都在你院子里做什么啊？”
听到这话，冯翊连忙走上前来，“夏师姐，我们是来吃婆婆做的饭的！”
“吃饭？”夏景景惊讶地看向叶晚秋，“婆婆，怎么还要给他们这么多人做饭？”
她看着满院子的人，少说也有十几个了，婆婆那里能做这么多人的饭？万一累坏了婆婆可怎么办？
听到这话，冯翊上前解释：“夏师姐，之前我在院门口经过的时候闻到了婆婆做的饭，我从没吃过这么好吃的饭……”
“所以你就让婆婆一个人做给你们这么多人吗？”夏景景出口打断他的话，语气里带了稍许愠怒。
平时婆婆准备她们几个人的饭菜已经很辛苦了，这么多人，婆婆不知道有多累。
夏景景目光不善的看向面前众人，“婆婆脾气好，好说话，但不是你们欺负她的借口。”
虽说当初带婆婆回来的时候，说的是她做个杂役弟子做饭，但不代表要给这么多人做饭。
看夏景景这气呼呼挡在自己面前，维护自己的模样，叶晚秋心里浮现出几分欣慰。
哪一家白眼狼，可从来没有这样维护过她。
“景景，”叶晚秋上前拉住她的胳膊，“事情不是你想的那样，你听我说。”

上一秒快要拔剑的夏景景乖乖被她拉着走到一旁。
几个杂役弟子站在原地，颇有几分不知所措。
“冯翊，这到底是怎么回事啊？”
冯翊摇摇头，他怎么知道？
昨天来婆婆院子里的时候只有她一个人。
还有那夏景景师姐，之前见面时很好说话啊，怎么今天在婆婆的院子里见了他们后变成了这样一副模样？
“夏师姐这么生气，一会儿是不是就要把我们赶走了？”
“可是我真想尝尝婆婆做的饭啊！怎么办啊？”
几人看着叶晚秋和夏景景的背影，心都要提起来了。
这边，夏景景跟着叶晚秋走到了院子的另一边。
“婆婆，怎么今日来了这么多杂役弟子？是不是有人欺负你了？你跟我说，看我不帮你把公道讨回来！”
她说着提起自己的剑，那模样好似叶晚秋开头，她就能立马冲上前去。
叶晚秋连忙拉住她，解释道：“不是不是！景景你别冲动，听我说。”
夏景景点头：“婆婆你说。”
content_en:
"Mother-in-law! I'm coming!"
After successfully building the foundation, Xia Jingjing came to Ye Wanqiu immediately after leaving seclusion, but when she saw the people in the yard, she was so surprised that her jaw almost dropped.
She just didn't come over for two days. What's going on? Why are there suddenly so many people in my mother-in-law's yard?
There are also people surrounding Ye Wanqiu who are calling her mother-in-law one by one. Is this your mother-in-law? Just call her!
The more Xia Jingjing thought about it, the more aggrieved she felt, and she quickly walked into the courtyard.
"Mother-in-law!"
She shouted something resentful, and the noisy courtyard suddenly fell silent.
Xia Jingjing quickly walked to Ye Wanqiu and took her arm.
"Mother-in-law, what are they doing in your yard?"
Hearing this, Feng Yi quickly stepped forward and said, "Senior Sister Xia, we are here to eat the food cooked by my mother-in-law!"
"Eat?" Xia Jingjing looked at Ye Wanqiu in surprise, "Mother-in-law, why do you still have to cook for so many of them?"
She looked at the people in the yard. There were at least a dozen people. How could her mother-in-law cook for so many people? What if my mother-in-law is exhausted?
Hearing this, Feng Yi stepped forward to explain: "Senior Sister Xia, when I passed by the courtyard gate before, I smelled the food cooked by my mother-in-law. I have never eaten such delicious food..."
"So you just let your mother-in-law do it for all of you?" Xia Jingjing interrupted him, with a slightly sullen tone in her tone.
Normally, my mother-in-law has a hard time preparing meals for the few of them. With so many people, she doesn’t know how tired she is.
Xia Jingjing looked at the people in front of her with unkind eyes, "My mother-in-law has a good temper and is easy to talk to, but that doesn't give you an excuse to bully her."
Although when I brought my mother-in-law back, it was said that she would be a handyman and cook, but it didn't mean that she would cook for so many people.
Seeing Xia Jingjing angrily standing in front of him and defending himself, Ye Wanqiu felt a little relieved.
What kind of white-eyed wolf has never defended her like this?
"Jingjing," Ye Wanqiu stepped forward and took her arm, "Things are not what you think. You listen to me."
Xia Jingjing, who was about to draw her sword a second ago, was pulled aside obediently by her.
Several handyman disciples stood there, quite at a loss.
"Feng Yi, what on earth is going on?"
Feng Yi shook his head, how did he know?
When I came to my mother-in-law's yard yesterday, she was the only one.
And Senior Sister Xia Jingjing, she was very talkative when we met before. Why did she become like this after meeting them in her mother-in-law's yard today?
"Senior Sister Xia is so angry. Will she drive us away soon?"
"But I really want to taste the food cooked by my mother-in-law! What should I do?"
Several people looked at the backs of Ye Wanqiu and Xia Jingjing with their hearts rising.
Here, Xia Jingjing followed Ye Wanqiu to the other side of the yard.
"Mother-in-law, why are there so many handyman disciples here today? Is someone bullying you? Tell me if I don't help you get justice!"
As she spoke, she raised her sword, which looked like Ye Wanqiu's first words, and she could immediately rush forward.
Ye Wanqiu quickly grabbed her and explained, "No, no! Jingjing, don't be impulsive, just listen to me."
Xia Jingjing nodded: "Mother-in-law, tell me."
